GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

  • Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
  • Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
  • Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
  • Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
  • Improving service accounts and secure automation
  • Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you'll do

  • Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
  • Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
  • Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
  • Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
  • Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
  • Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
  • Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

What you'll bring

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
  • Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
  • Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
  • Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
  • Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

About the team

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility …

About the Role:
An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth.
As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.
At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do:
• 
Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises.
• 
Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog.
• 
Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate.
• 
Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model.
• 
Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way.

What You Will Bring to the Role:
Must Haves:
• 
Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity.
• 
Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.
• 
Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.
• 
Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.
• 
Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance.
• 
Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
Nice to Haves:
• 
Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.
• 
Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.
• 
Experience implementing IAM federation.
• 
Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.
• 
Experience with L3 support/incident management.
• 
Experience working in a fully remote organization.

We are seeking a skilled and innovative Machine Learning Engineer with expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and an interest in the latest AI models . This role focuses on driving innovation by introducing non-traditional approaches, deploying scalable models, and implementing advanced AI techniques to solve real-world challenges. • Streamlining processes for better estimation and scaling solutions.

• Collaborate with teams to identify opportunities for applying AI and ML to solve complex problems efficiently.
• Build and productionize deep learning models, ensuring seamless integration into existing systems.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
• 2-4 years of experience in machine learning or applied AI roles.
• Strong Python skills with experience in hosting and maintaining ML models at scale.
• Proficiency in a deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow).
• Ability to explore and evaluate research papers, identifying key methods and techniques for application.
• Capable of combining existing tools and frameworks to create efficient and effective solutions.
• Solid foundation in machine learning principles and statistical techniques.
• Strong communication skills to convey complex ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with cloud platforms, containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and production-level AI workflows.
• Experience working with domain-specific data, such as clinical or biomedical datasets.
• Interest in cutting-edge AI techniques, with aspirations to co-author research or contribute to industry advancements.
• Knowledge of advanced NLP techniques, including prompt engineering and refinement frameworks.
• Exposure to signal processing applications in various domains.

This role is ideal for individuals passionate about combining technical expertise and innovative thinking to address unique challenges and shape the future of AI applications.

About the role:
As a Technical Writer at Camunda, you'll be embedded within product teams, taking full ownership of documentation for key areas of our platform. You'll work side-by-side with engineers, product managers, and designers to ensure our documentation is clear, accurate, and closely aligned with the product experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll become a subject matter expert, directly shaping the developer journey through high-impact content across the Camunda platform.

Beyond content, you'll help maintain and configure the infrastructure that keeps our documentation running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can unblock themselves and the team when something breaks. Day to day, this can mean:

• 
Troubleshooting and fixing failing GitHub Actions workflows, including reading CI logs, isolating the breaking change, and getting the build green again.
• 
Reviewing and merging contributions from engineers and the wider community, and keeping branches and versioned docs releases in good shape.
• 
Diagnosing broken links, redirects, MDX and rendering errors, and search indexing issues across current and versioned content.
• 
Handling Docusaurus, Node, and dependency upgrades, and resolving the breakages that come with them.
• 
Improving the tooling, automation, and linting that writers and contributors rely on, so our publishing process stays fast and predictable

You don't need to be a full-time developer, but you should be confident with Git and GitHub workflows, the command line, YAML and JavaScript-based config, Markdown/MDX, and reading an error trace far enough to know whether you can fix it or need to pull in an engineer.

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team focused on helping developers become productive with Camunda technologies quickly and joyfully. Developers with technical writing experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Be Doing:
• 
Own and drive the documentation for one or more product areas, acting as the embedded technical writer within the corresponding product teams.
• 
Maintain and improve our documentation site's technical infrastructure, including build tooling, deployment pipelines, and Docusaurus platform configuration, to keep publishing fast, reliable, and scalable.
• 
Work closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to stay deeply informed about the product roadmap and ensure documentation is accurate, timely, and aligned with feature development.
• 
Become a subject matter expert in your assigned product areas, developing hands-on experience with Camunda products to create documentation that reflects real-world usage and developer needs.
• 
Lead documentation efforts from concept through to release, including planning, writing, reviewing, and maintaining content that empowers developers to succeed with Camunda technologies.
• 
Advocate for documentation as a critical part of the user experience, bringing the user’s perspective into product discussions and influencing design and implementation where appropriate.
• 
Continuously improve the structure, clarity, and completeness of the documentation based on analytics, user feedback, and your own insights.
• 
Collaborate with other writers and the broader Documentation team to share best practices, contribute to team goals, and evolve our documentation tooling and standards.
What You Bring:
• 
3+ years of technical writing experience and a strong portfolio of developer-focused content such as user guides, installation guides, API references, tutorials, and technical blog posts.
• 
Proven experience of maintaining, troubleshooting, configuring, and extending documentation site infrastructure and deployment pipelines, preferably using Docusaurus.
• 
Hands-on experience with Java, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and related technologies, and a proven ability to deeply understand, use, and test complex technical products (ideally with Camunda 8 or similar products).
• 
Experience with writing about on-premise software installation or other technical environments, as well as SaaS and software documentation.
• 
Proven ability to tailor content for diverse audiences and technical backgrounds, including software engineers, application developers, business analysts, and process owners.
• 
Experience with docs-as-code workflows and documentation frameworks such as Docusaurus, and using AI, Git, and Markdown in a developer-centric environment.
• 
Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
 Nice-to-haves:
• 
Software engineering experience, or proficiency with one or more programming languages.
• 
Comfortable iterating on an existing technical writing style guide and advocating for its cross-functional use.

5c30784413e76cd5.description: ## This is not a normal software engineering role At ClearFeed, using AI to build software is not optional. Every engineer is expected to use AI every day — to understand code, write code, review code, debug issues, design product flows, generate tests, write docs, explore APIs, and ship faster. We expect you to be comfortable using tools like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI tools as part of your default engineering workflow. If you do not know how to use AI effectively to write code, debug issues, understand unfamiliar systems, and improve your own engineering output, **please do not apply**. We are looking for engineers who can use AI as leverage — while still bringing strong judgment, ownership, and engineering taste. AI can write a lot of the first draft. You are responsible for the final result. ## What we are building ClearFeed is building an AI-first support platform for modern teams working in Slack and Microsoft Teams. Our product connects conversations, tickets, knowledge bases, engineering tools, CRMs, and AI agents so companies can resolve customer and internal requests faster. Our engineers work on real product problems: * How should an AI agent understand a support conversation? * When should it answer automatically, and when should it ask a human? * How do we safely connect Slack, Teams, Zendesk, Jira, GitHub, Linear, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other tools? * How do we make AI workflows observable, debuggable, and trustworthy? * How do we ship fast without creating chaos for customers? ## What you will do You will take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into working software. That may include API design, backend logic, database changes, Slack/Teams workflows, AI-agent behavior, product UX, tests, monitoring, and deployment. You will be expected to: * Use AI tools heavily while writing and reviewing code. * Use AI to create first-pass designs, specs, implementation plans, tests, and docs. * Build backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, and cloud infrastructure. * Work on AI-agent features involving LLMs, RAG, tool-calling, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and observability. * Own features end to end: idea → design → implementation → testing → release → production debugging. * Debug production issues and improve the system after every incident. * Improve our engineering system itself: better prompts, better internal tools, better test generation, better review loops, better deployment workflows. * Move fast, but stay accountable for what ships. ## What “AI-native” means here We do not mean “vibe code and hope it works.” We mean: * You can use AI to move significantly faster. * You can use AI to write, refactor, test, and debug code. * You can review AI-generated code critically. * You understand that AI is often confidently wrong. * You can use AI for product thinking, but you do not outsource judgment. * You can ship faster without lowering quality. * You can explain your decisions clearly to humans. The best engineers in the next decade will not be the ones who manually type the most code. They will be the ones who combine product judgment, technical depth, and AI leverage to ship high-quality software faster than traditional teams. ## What we are looking for You may be a good fit if: * You are already using AI coding tools daily. * You are faster today than you were one year ago because of AI. * You have strong software fundamentals and do not blindly trust generated code. * You can work across backend, product, integrations, and basic frontend when needed. * You care about customer experience, not just clean abstractions. * You enjoy working in small teams with high ownership. * You can take a problem statement and come back with a working solution. * You are comfortable with ambiguity. * You like shipping. * You are curious, direct, and low-ego. ## Bonus points We will pay extra attention if you have: * Built something real using AI agents. * Used Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, v0, Lovable, Replit, or similar tools seriously. * Shipped a side project using AI. * Built integrations with Slack, Teams, Zendesk, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, or HubSpot. * Worked on support, developer tools, workflow automation, or B2B SaaS products. * Written about your engineering work. * Open-source contributions or visible proof of work. ## How we evaluate We use AI in our hiring process for the same reason we use it in engineering: it helps everyone move faster and spend time where human judgment matters most. The first step is a short AI-led interview of around 15 minutes. It helps us understand your background, your experience, and how you think about building software. After that, you will have three technical discussions with our team: * Problem solving + debugging * Problem solving * System design We want to understand how you reason, how you debug, how you make trade-offs, and how well you can combine engineering fundamentals with AI tools to build reliable software faster. ## What you get We want engineers to have the tools, support, and environment to do their best work. ### Flexible AI Credits You will get flexible AI credits and access to the tools you need to build faster — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, or whatever genuinely helps you ship better software. We do not want engineers hesitating before using AI because of subscription limits or tool access. ### Health and medical support You get comprehensive medical insurance, along with **free doctor consultations**. We are a small team, but we want to be thoughtful about health, family, and emergencies. You should not have to figure everything out on your own when something medical comes up. ### Sports and team activities We sponsor badminton and cricket games for the team. Not mandatory forced-fun activities. Just real sports, real games, and a good way to spend time with people outside tickets, PRs, and production issues. ## How to apply Apply here or send your resume to jobs@clearfeed.ai with: * Your LinkedIn, GitHub, or resume. * One thing you have built that you are proud of. * A short note on how you use AI in your engineering workflow. * Optional: a Loom/video/walkthrough of something you built.
